metadata.description:
Perched mysteriously in Prospect Park, the “Witches Hat Tower” looks like it fell out of a fairy tale and landed among the trees. Officially named the Prospect Park Water Tower, it once offered panoramic views of the city—but its locked gate and peculiar charm now fuel urban legends. It’s weird, it’s wonderful, and yes, it’s real. You’ve earned this Minneapolis Marvel POAP by seeking out the strange and storied in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Minneapolis Marvel 
GPS: 44.96872, -93.21267 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.96872,-93.21267
